about: The Juggernaut's own sounds. The voice ("Autocraft Juggernaut", made with Voice Design, eleven_ttv_v3) is a heavy-armoured grenadier, deep, gruff and deliberate but clipped and crisp on his helmet radio, well below the Ranger, the Comet and the Prospector; its lines go through comm.py like theirs. Ids match the game's sound names (sfx/<name>_<n>): vjuggernaut = reports in, juggernautdeath = death cry, breacher = both grenade launchers (one volley per shot, every 1.07 s, heard where the Juggernaut stands).

entries.text: [gruff, deliberate, over a helmet radio] Heavy armor, reporting. Point me at something big.
[low, unhurried] Launchers loaded. Nobody outruns a grenade.
[calm, gritty] Plates sealed. I slow them down, you finish them.
[slow, menacing] Grenadier on station. Send me the tanks.

entries.prompt: heavy sci-fi grenade launcher firing two rounds a split second apart, deep hollow thoomp thoomp, metallic clack of the breech, short rumbling tail, close up
loud twin arm-mounted grenade launchers on power armor fire almost together, two punchy pneumatic thumps, heavy mechanical recoil clank, deep boom tail, close up
two concussive grenade launches in quick succession, deep bassy whump and a hiss of propellant, armored metal clunk, brief echo
